description: Addition of a new storey to the house and bedroom in roof space and extension of front porch.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( [Z-635-D002, Z-635-D003, Z-635-D004, Z-635-D005, Z-635-D006, Z-635-D007, Z-635-D008, TQRQM18306103257692, Z-635-D014, Received: 29/01/2021] [Z-635-D009 Rev A, Z-635-D010 Rev A, Z-635-D011 Rev A, Z-635-D012 Rev A, Received: 12/03/2021] ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The hereby approved extensions and walls of the existing house shall be finished in white/off white or similar coloured render and the roof shall be finished in tiles to match the colour of the existing house or of a red/brown/grey colour. All other materials used in the exterior of the hereby approved shall match those of the existing house.  The top and front face of the side parapet and the area on the front roof slope immediately below the proposed box gutter shall all be clad in tiles to match the rest of the new roof.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the side elevations of the hereby approved extensions shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing
